prompt: Keep the real layout, perspective and lighting of the reference photo, the angled close view of a monitor with its handle on top and cables hanging below, now mounted on the wall of an ambulance at night. The screen is the brightest thing in the frame: the heart trace runs dead flat from edge to edge in green, every other line flat beneath it, and the readouts on the right have all dropped to dashes. A small red alarm light glows on the plain, unmarked housing. In the bottom corner, blurred, a gloved hand still lies on the patient's chest, a dark green cuff at the wrist. The cabin is dim; streaks of blue emergency light pass over the white plastic, and a rain-spotted window behind throws a faint orange street-lamp glow. Still, silent, final. Vertical 9:16. Night in the rain, like a real 35 mm film photo: sodium-orange street lamps, cold teal shadows, blue emergency lights. Thanks.
